description: [2 IN 1 ORAL CARE SOLUTION] This electric toothbrush and water flosser combo allows you brush, floss, or do both at once. The built-in smart two-minute timer that buzzes every 30 seconds to keep you moving the brush to all four quadrants of your mouth [Fast Charging & Long Battery Life] Convenient fast charging base eliminates cable clutter. It also comes with a compact travel case that keeps everything—your power handle, extra tips, travel water hose, and charging base—organized and protected on the go. The included travel hose makes it easy to use both the water flosser and electric toothbrush, so you never have to compromise your dental routine while traveling [Effective Plaque Removal & Gum Care] This flossing toothbrush is up to 2x more effective at removing plaque than manual brushing and flossing alone—especially in those hard-to-reach areas between teeth and below the gumline. With multiple water pressure settings, it’s easy to customize your cleaning experience: higher pressure levels are ideal for smokers or those who drink coffee, tea, or wine regularly, helping to target stubborn stains. For those with sensitive gums, lower pressure settings provide a gentler, more comfortable clean [Helpful Tips for Best Results] The sleek toothbrush unit comes with a suction-base docking station that fits easily on most bathroom countertops. For optimal results, we recommend using the water flosser first to remove debris and clean between teeth, followed by brushing. This allows the fluoride from your toothpaste to stay on your teeth longer and do its job. Brushing and flossing with water at the same time may dilute the toothpaste, reducing its effectiveness
